subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The decision to engage in an armed conflict is __tacit__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"implied without being stated".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tacit:** (मौन स्वीकृति) - Understood or implied without being stated.

 
 
• **Example**: His silence was taken as tacit agreement.
 
 
 
• **Implied without being stated: **(बिना कहे समझा गया) - Suggested or understood without being directly expressed.

Therefore, the correct answer is "implied without being stated".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incomprehensible for some:** (कुछ के लिए असमझ) - Difficult to understand.
 
• **Ineffective completely:** (पूरी तरह से प्रभावहीन) - Not producing any significant or desired effect.
 
• **Regretted by everyone:** (सभी द्वारा खेदित) - Felt sorry about something by everyone.
